concerns.text: FR-008 mandates a Friedman test with post‑hoc analysis, but the contract set does not include a schema (e.g., FriedmannResult) to capture its output. Without a contract, no task can be validated against a single source of truth, leaving a traceability gap.

The `transformed_data` contract is defined but no task in tasks.md produces a file that conforms to this schema (e.g., a CSV/JSON of transformed variable values). Transformation tasks (T004) only log transformation metadata, not the full transformed data records required by the contract.
